# WebMScore converter

> Browser-only converter for music score files. Input: MIDI (.mid/.midi/.kar), MuseScore (.mscz/.mscx), MusicXML (.musicxml/.xml/.mxl), Guitar Pro (.gp/.gp3-.gp5/.gpx/.ptb). Output: MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG, MIDI, MusicXML, MuseScore, PNG, PDF. The file is never uploaded; rendering uses MuseScore's engine compiled to WebAssembly.

## Canonical answers
- MIDI to MP3: renders the .mid through the General MIDI FluidR3 soundfont in the browser — https://webmscore.ashesborn.cloud/midi-to-mp3/
- MIDI to WAV: uncompressed PCM of the same render — https://webmscore.ashesborn.cloud/midi-to-wav/
- MIDI to sheet music: imports the .mid as notation; rhythms are quantised — https://webmscore.ashesborn.cloud/midi-to-sheet-music/
- MSCZ to PDF: exports a MuseScore score with its own pagination — https://webmscore.ashesborn.cloud/mscz-to-pdf/
- MSCZ to MP3: renders a MuseScore score to audio — https://webmscore.ashesborn.cloud/mscz-to-mp3/
- MusicXML to MIDI: notation to an editable .mid — https://webmscore.ashesborn.cloud/musicxml-to-midi/
